CREATE TABLE "public"."nt_notificacion_riesgo" (
  "atendida" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id_incidencia" uuid,
  "id_notificacion" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_riesgo" uuid,
  "severidad" text,
  "tipo_evento_riesgo" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_notificacion"),
  CONSTRAINT "nt_notificacion_riesgo_severidad_check_1ba7cc40" CHECK ("severidad" IN ('BAJO', 'MEDIO', 'ALTO')),
  CONSTRAINT "nt_notificacion_riesgo_tipo_evento_riesgo_check_ee6896fe" CHECK ("tipo_evento_riesgo" IN ('RIESGO_CRITICO', 'INCIDENCIA_REGISTRADA', 'PLAN_ACTIVADO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_activacion_plan" (
  "fecha_activacion" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_activacion_plan" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_incidencia" uuid,
  "id_plan_contingencia" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_usuario_registro" int4 NOT NULL,
  "observacion" character varying(1000),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_activacion_plan")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_categoria_riesgo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "codigo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(500),
  "id_categoria_riesgo" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_categoria_riesgo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_costo_riesgo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "concepto" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_costo_presupuesto" uuid,
  "id_costo_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_incidencia" uuid,
  "id_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "monto" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_costo_riesgo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_documento_costo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_costo_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_documento_costo_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "tipo" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "url" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_documento_costo_riesgo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_incidencia" (
  "atendida" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "critica" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_incidencia" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_incidencia" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_incidencia")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_mitigacion_riesgo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'SUGERIDA' NOT NULL,
  "id_mitigacion_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_mitigacion" int4,
  "id_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_mitigacion_riesgo"),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_mitigacion_riesgo_estado_check_0f5ae68f" CHECK ("estado" IN ('SUGERIDA', 'APLICADA', 'DESCARTADA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_plan_contingencia" (
  "accion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "alternativa" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_plan_contingencia" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_usuario_responsable" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_plan_contingencia"),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_plan_contingencia_alternativa_check_7fad8842" CHECK ("alternativa" IN ('PLAN_A', 'PLAN_B', 'PLAN_C'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_plantilla_mitigacion" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_mitigacion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_riesgo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "severidadMinima" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_plantilla_mitigacion"),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_plantilla_mitigacion_severidadMinima_check_8d5c1920" CHECK ("severidadMinima" IN ('BAJO', 'MEDIO', 'ALTO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_plantilla_plan" (
  "accion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "alternativa" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_plan" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_riesgo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_plantilla_plan"),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_plantilla_plan_alternativa_check_7fad8842" CHECK ("alternativa" IN ('PLAN_A', 'PLAN_B', 'PLAN_C'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_plantilla_riesgo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "causa_probable" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "codigo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "efecto_potencial" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "id_categoria_riesgo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_plantilla_riesgo" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_plantilla_riesgo")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rg_riesgo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "causa_probable" character varying(1000),
  "costo_asociado" numeric(12,2),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000),
  "efecto_potencial" character varying(1000),
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'IDENTIFICADO' NOT NULL,
  "id_categoria_riesgo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_matrimonio" uuid,
  "id_plantilla_riesgo" int4,
  "id_proyecto" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_riesgo" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_usuario_responsable" int4,
  "impacto" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "probabilidad" int4 NOT NULL,
  "severidad" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_riesgo"),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_riesgo_estado_check_95b90dd1" CHECK ("estado" IN ('IDENTIFICADO', 'EN_TRATAMIENTO', 'ACTIVO', 'CERRADO')),
  CONSTRAINT "rg_riesgo_severidad_check_1ba7cc40" CHECK ("severidad" IN ('BAJO', 'MEDIO', 'ALTO'))
)
